scientific_integrity: Analytic proof uses multivariate Weyl equidistribution and exact polynomial finite differences; integer-arithmetic tests are finite diagnostics, not a proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Degree at least one and irrational leading coefficient required; lower coefficients arbitrary real.
No quantitative finite-prefix discrepancy bound or classification at longer block lengths.
Unindexed equivalent work in generalized-polynomial or symbolic-dynamics literature is not excluded.
title: Sharp block-universality threshold for integer parts of irrational polynomials
